description: Land Aquisition - Boralesgamuwa, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically divesting certain land allotments from state control. It contains detailed land descriptions, plot numbers, boundaries, and locations, but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the land-related legal action being taken.
